identification: Three-piece lot of modern folk-art (tole-painted) items: black oval hat tin/hat box with painted flowers, tall black cylindrical tin (milk/cream can style) with painted flowers and a lid painted '1990' plus a small initials roundel (looks like WH or MH), a boot last and a cast-iron flat (sad) iron.
